ProxyEdge -  Investment Company Report                   Report Date: 08/03/2005
Meeting Date Range: 07/01/2004 to 06/30/2005
Selected Accounts: Scudder Adv Funds II - EAFE Equity Index Fund

Scudder EAFE Equity Index, a series of Scudder  Advisor Funds II, is a feeder in
a  master/feeder  structure.  Accordingly,  Scudder EAFE Equity Index holds only
securities of its master fund, EAFE Equity Index Portfolio,  a series of Scudder
Investment  Portfolios.  Included in this filing is the proxy voting  record for
the EAFE Equity Index Portfolio.
